title: Add explicit autonomy growth snapshot CLI
summary: Add an explicit CLI for recording bounded autonomy growth snapshots during unattended soak runs.
reason: The growth snapshot helper exists, but operators and scheduled soak harnesses need a stable tool entrypoint that records diagnostics-state trend evidence without making normal diagnostics polling write state.
